nodes.title: Extract facts
nodes.prompt: Read sample-notes.md in the working folder. List every dated decision as one bullet, with its date and owner. Do not add anything that is not in the file.

nodes.title: Find open risks
nodes.prompt: Using the bullets from the extract step, list each open risk. For each risk, say which bullet it comes from. If no risk is stated, say so.

nodes.title: Write the summary
nodes.prompt: Write a short summary with two headings: Decisions and Open risks. Use only the content from the previous steps.
